caption: The image is a pencil drawing on a light beige background featuring a single ceramic pitcher. The pitcher is depicted in three-quarter view, with a large, curved handle on the right side and a pouring spout on the left. The body of the pitcher is adorned with intricate, raised floral patterns, including large flowers and leaves that wrap around the surface. The handle has a textured, organic appearance, possibly resembling a branch. The pitcher sits directly on the blank background with no other objects or decorative elements present. The drawing is rendered in grayscale, using shading to suggest depth and texture. The artist's signature, "Richard Whitaker," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Parian Ware Syrup Pitcher
